summary: Full-stack verification of iter260 features: (1) @mentions autocomplete + deep-link highlight in proposal Bitácora; (2) Portal 'Mensajes' tab (client posts + visibility gating of internal notes); (3) Client Portal Gate on proposal/quote docs (403 proposal_not_ready + exclusion from aggregates); (4) /api/culinary-digest/daily-insights shape + cache + refresh + CulinaryInsightsCard on Dashboard, /food-ops/menus and /food-ops/inventory?tab=lowstock. Backend pytest: 11/11 PASSED. Frontend Playwright: all critical flows PASSED. Regression: Ask the team / approve flow from iter259 intact (QA proposal remains Pending Approval and Approve/Withdraw buttons render correctly).
critical_code_review_comments: No DELETE endpoint exists for /api/documents (only GET/POST/PUT and /sign /send /regenerate). Pytest fixture cleanup uses requests.delete which silently 405s. Test docs were purged via direct mongo delete during this run. Suggest adding an admin DELETE route or soft-delete to make document tests fully self-cleaning.

GET /api/proposals/{proposal_id} (singular) is not routed (405/not-mounted). Only /api/proposals/event/{event_id} and sub-paths exist. If main agent later expects direct proposal fetch by id, this needs adding.

portal_post_message: pydantic Field(min_length=1) returns 422 on empty body/name; after strip() the manual 400 branch only triggers when body is whitespace-only. This is fine and matches the test expectation ((400,422)), but worth noting.
_portal_proposal_visible correctly short-circuits non-proposal/quote docs and legacy_signature_flow=true docs, and only enforces when require_approval is on — matched behavior verified end-to-end.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed. Each test created TEST_iter260_* / QA260_* notes and documents. All residual data (5 test documents + 4 test notes + related notifications) were purged via direct mongo cleanup. Confirmed: 0 residual notes/docs after run. QA proposal prop_qa_print_spacing_20260729 remains in document_status='Pending Approval' (unchanged).
